name: metis
description: Métis recovers a behaviour model from code, compares it against what somebody said the system should do, and generates human-executable test cases from the part that survives human review. Nothing auto-approves: an unreviewed model produces no tests.

plugins.name: metis
plugins.description: Five skills for the model-based testing pipeline: recover a behaviour model from a codebase and take it to the approval gate; turn a stated requirement into atomic acceptance criteria and reconcile them against the model; check a state machine for determinism, guard completeness, reachability and observability; extract Jira, Confluence, OpenAPI, Zephyr Scale, code or a database into one normalized intake document; and walk a reviewer through the model-approval gate. Skills route through the bundled metis agent, which is generated from the workflow registry.

plugins.name: metis-mcp
plugins.description: The Métis MCP server: twelve read-only tools over the behaviour graph and the knowledge in it — list workflows, route a request to one, read a model, validate it for well-formedness, report its coverage ledger, check where a run got to, explain why the surface cannot decide anything, and search or read the entities, requirements and specifications behind it. Read-only by construction (N-8): approval, landing and publication go through the gated CLI, because a decision needs evidence a chat session cannot present. Install alongside the metis plugin to give its skills a live graph to work against.
